title: Typed imported-handler boundaries and shared database pool ownership

acceptanceCriteria.description: carrier-accounts.ts and store-accounts.ts compile under strict TypeScript, consume shared credential normalization and persistence owners, and use the process-wide database pool.
rates-multi.ts uses the typed Node adapter contract and contains no local TypeScript suppression or database-pool constructor.
Shopify, Walmart, and eBay imported handlers are typed at their Node/JSON boundary and delegate provider work to connector owners without introducing live calls in certification.

All eight files under src/lib/imported-handlers contain zero @ts-nocheck directives, construct zero postgres() clients, never close the shared pool, and delegate normal connection ownership to src/db/client.ts.

Strict backend/frontend TypeScript, the production web build, credential and tenant-scope behavior, connector boundaries, marketplace guards, and all 56 mandatory source-of-truth commands pass at the reviewed stable SHA.

The closure is exact-SHA governed and offline: malformed/stale evidence is rejected and certification creates no database connection, credential migration, label, postage purchase, provider notification, or production data mutation.

canonicalOwners: src/lib/node-handler.ts owns the typed NodeStyleRequest/NodeStyleResponse contract and shared JSON body parser
src/db/client.ts owns the process-wide postgres.js pool used by ordinary request handlers
src/lib/credential-accounts.ts and src/services/credential-accounts.ts own credential normalization and persistence
src/services/credential-account-schema.ts owns migration readiness checks without runtime data migration
drizzle/0063_credential_account_cutover.sql owns the idempotent legacy credential-row cutover
src/connectors/carrier and src/connectors/store own provider payload translation and provider communication

oldOwners.path: local untyped request/response and JSON readers inside imported handlers
per-request postgres() clients and handler-owned pool shutdown
request-time migration of legacy marketplace credential rows

wrappers.delegatesTo: typed Node adapter, shared credential services, shared DB pool, and provider connector owners
shared credential normalization, JSON parsing, schema readiness, and persistence owners

sotBypass.details: Imported handlers remain thin ports. They validate transport intent and delegate typed parsing, credentials, database connections, and provider behavior to named backend owners.

verification.command: No migration is added or modified by the PS-456 exact-SHA closure commit; historical migration 0063 is verified by the imported-handler and credential guards.

migrations.rollbackPlan: The closure adds documentation only. If the typed-handler implementation must be rolled back, use a reviewed forward revert of application code while preserving already-applied additive migration 0063 and all later migrations; never reverse credential rows in a request handler.

rollback.strategy: Forward-revert the packet-only closure commit if its evidence is invalid. A product rollback must separately forward-revert the bounded handler changes while keeping the shared migration history and database facts intact.

liveVerification.reason: PS-456 certification is a strict typing, ownership, and offline provider-boundary proof. It changes no runtime code at the reviewed SHA and requires no live credential, provider, label, or database operation.
